title: The Smiling Visitor
author: Emrys Lockridge
blurb: Kestrel Quintana, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
